thread.title: Push chats and add future directions

source: Codex app read_thread; all available pages

messages.text: Push the contents of this folder to the git hub. All of the chats. Also include a file with directions for future work. In particular, we need to find better expositions for the arithmetic and analytic bounds. The idea is then to see why the argument (the new, simplified argument, doesn't generalize to zeta(7) and higher odd zeta values).
I’ll check the folder, GitHub connection, and chat history, then prepare the files and future-work directions for the push.

The folder has no Git remote yet, but the earlier project work points to `dozenalist/Mathathon`. I also found that the older ζ(7) audit concerns different estimates from the simplified argument, so the future-work directions will make that distinction explicit.
